# DialogCloseReason

`Flare.Abstractions.DialogCloseReason`

Why a dialog is being dismissed - passed to a BeforeClose guard so it can decide whether to allow or veto the close (e.g. block a scrim click while there are unsaved changes).

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ScrimClick` | `0` | The user clicked the scrim/backdrop behind the dialog. |
| `EscapeKey` | `1` | The user pressed the Escape key. |
| `CloseButton` | `2` | The user clicked the built-in header close button. |

## Used by components

- `FlareDialog`
